segments.normalizedSource: ```swift override func viewDidLoad() { super.viewDidLoad() // Assign the view controller as the browser delegate. launchOptions.browserViewController.delegate = self // Customize launch options. launchOptions.title = "My Text Editor" launchOptions.background.backgroundColor = .darkGray // Provide an action for the secondary action. let templateAction = LaunchOptions.createDocumentAction(withIntent: .template) templateAction.title = "Choose a Template" launchOptions.secondaryAction = templateAction mySetupTextView() } ```
